project: History2 Korean History II learning webapp

day1_to_day6.policy: Preserve workbook/textbook original stems and options. Do not rewrite source questions solely to make them harder.
day1_to_day6.existing_structural_audit: V6_CONTENT_AUDIT.json reports 140 problems, 55 concepts, 0 structural errors and 0 warnings.
day1_to_day6.quality_support: Option-level feedback, concept-depth recovery and original-question retry compensate for weak or simple source items without breaking source fidelity.

day7_to_day18.policy: Self-authored fast/test questions may be improved when distractors are implausible, answer position is predictable, or the prompt tests only superficial recognition.
major_findings: Correct answers were frequently concentrated in the first option in several fast/test sets.
Some distractors were from obviously unrelated periods or categories and could be removed without knowing the target concept.
Several items asked only for a year/name even when a relationship or application question was appropriate.
Keyword-only depth heuristics could under-classify comparison/application items.

runtime_changes.answer_balance: Correct-answer position is deterministically distributed by question id. Correct content is preserved while option order and answer index move together.
runtime_changes.normal_learning: fast_day.html loads the quality patch before fast_boost_hook.js; fast_day_engine.js uses the audited diagnosis when available.
runtime_changes.adaptive_review: adaptive_fast_review.html loads the same quality patch and adaptive_fast_review.js uses the same audited diagnosis.
runtime_changes.history_policy: Existing historical correct/incorrect records are not rewritten. Weakness profiling continues to rely on question id and correctness rather than old option text.

depth_policy.D4: comparison, plausible-distractor discrimination, balanced interpretation, application
depth_policy.implementation: Per-question qualityDiagnosis overrides the generic keyword heuristic; legacy heuristic remains fallback.

non_goals: Do not make every question difficult.
Do not remove deliberate spaced review across chapter tests.
Do not modify source-based Day 1-6 original options solely for difficulty.
Do not change Firebase persistence or learner-history keys.
